title: CSI: how the cluster talks to the provider’s storage

videos.script: Lesson 26 asked for a volume and got one, without saying how. Somebody made a disk, and somebody mounted it into the pod. {{who}} For years that somebody was code inside Kubernetes itself, one driver per cloud. Every new storage product meant a change to Kubernetes. {{intree}} The Container Storage Interface ended that. It is a short list of calls: create a volume, delete it, stage it on a node, publish it into a pod. A storage vendor implements the calls, and Kubernetes makes them. {{calls}} You will install a small CSI driver, claim a volume from it, and then read the driver's own log, call by call, to see what the cluster asked for and when. {{plan}}
